summary: Pull request establishes React + TypeScript Electron template foundation but contains multiple critical issues: (1) Missing DOM type definitions causing Cannot find name window/document errors, (2) ShaderMaterial component returns object instead of JSX element breaking Three.js fiber integration, (3) ESLint package missing from devDependencies despite lint script being defined, (4) Original package.json had non-existent dependency versions that require fixes. TypeScript strict mode catches unused variables and incorrect component types.
reviewedAreas: IPC via contextBridge - preload/index.ts properly exposes only three methods (notifySpeechStart, notifySpeechEnd, getTTSAudio) with correct type signatures
OpenAI timeout handling - main.ts uses AbortController with parseInt(process.env.OPENAI_TIMEOUT || "30000", 10) for configurable timeout
Three.js shader material - App.tsx implements Digital Noir custom fragment shader with simplex noise, but component structure is invalid (returns object instead of JSX element)
Electron IPC security - contextIsolation enabled, nodeIntegration disabled, preload script isolates renderer from main process Node.js APIs
Hyprland integration - hyprland.conf contains four window rules for floating, noborder, pin, noanim behaviors
Type configuration - tsconfig.json missing dom in lib array preventing browser API type checking
blockers: critical:src/renderer/App.tsx:25-84 ShaderMaterial component returns object instead of JSX mesh element breaking Three.js fiber integration
critical:tsconfig.json:6-8 Missing dom in lib array causing TS errors on window,document and all browser APIs throughout renderer code
medium:package.json Missing eslint in devDependencies despite lint script defined
high:package.json dependencies Original versions @electron-toolkit/tsconfig@^1.0.2 (not published) and @ricky0123/vad-web@^1.0.5 (max 0.0.31) cannot install
medium:src/main/main.ts:43, src/renderer/App.tsx:51-52 Unused variable declarations trigger TS errors in strict mode
medium:src/main/main.ts:60-63 Error handling returns null after throw which is redundant
fixes: Add dom to tsconfig.json lib array
Restructure ShaderMaterial component to return proper JSX element or Three.js material wrapper
Remove unused setIsSpeaking and setAmplitude state variables from App.tsx
Add eslint package to devDependencies with version ^8.57.0
residualRisks: ShaderMaterial shader code simplified from original implementation may affect visual aesthetic goals
Environment variable handling for ELECTRON_RENDERER_PATH and OPENAI_TIMEOUT requires external setup not documented in package.json
